verdict.rationale: Typesense is clearly API-driven. Collections, indexing, search, filtering and curation are all documented as API operations, and a community user notes its REST interface. The Typesense Cloud MCP server reportedly lets an agent create and configure clusters, build collections, index data, tune search and read metrics, which suggests Cloud management is also programmatic. However, no evidence states that the API matches everything the Cloud UI can do, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a public OpenAPI spec, documented Cloud management API coverage beyond the MCP summary, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
